title: Cross-Primitive Consistency in Jev
author: Xu Liu, Guikun Chen, Kanzhi Wu, Wenguan Wang

summary: Jev enables efficient decision-making with large language models (LLMs) through typed querying primitives, allowing the same semantic state to be expressed in different formats, such as binary and multiple-choice queries. However, the consistency of decisions across primitives has not been systematically evaluated.
takeaways: However, the consistency of decisions across primitives has not been systematically evaluated.
Our findings establish cross-primitive consistency as a key dimension for evaluating Jev and provide a practical approach to improving the reliability of its decisions.
This work introduces PrimaCons, a four-axis benchmark for assessing cross-primitive consistency while preserving the semantics of the query.
